note: Prepared, model-independent prompts are committed here. Historical experiment metadata retains original paths. Raw FEVER train claims must be downloaded to verifier/data/fever/train.jsonl.
schema: Each labeled_prompts.jsonl row includes id, gold, prompt and completion; extra fields vary by set.

sets.name: sft-oracle-full
sets.description: Gold-page evidence prompts for 2B/4B SFT; 6000 requested, 5895 usable.

sets.name: sft-oracle-smoke-60
sets.description: 60-claim SFT smoke set shared by 2B and 4B.

sets.name: sft-oracle-matched-grpo-1200
sets.description: 1200-claim SFT subset matched to the GRPO comparison.

sets.name: grpo-fever-titles-1200
sets.description: Matched FEVER claims with title-match retrieval, not guaranteed gold in context.

sets.name: grpo-fever-nei-pages-removed-1200
sets.description: Supported/refuted source claims with all gold evidence pages removed; NEI target.

sets.name: grpo-fever-nei-sentences-removed-1200
sets.description: Supported/refuted source claims with annotated evidence sentences removed; NEI target, potentially noisy.
